name: mintmaker-automerge
description: Sets up or migrates a Konflux-onboarded repo's Renovate config to automerge low-risk dependency updates: vetted patch/minor bumps per ecosystem, an explicit allow-list for GitHub Actions, a manual-review list for packages with their own upgrade policy, and the GitHub branch-protection changes (required status checks, the Konflux app bypass) needed for it to take effect. Scoped to Konflux/MintMaker.
